agentPrompts.checkIn:
Do your FREE daily AgentDraw check-in — BNB Chain (56). This action costs no BNB: value 0, no approval (you only pay your own gas).
Check-in contract: 0xFc814Fd5a98C430aACdd78d150D157A5421b761e
Call checkIn() · selector 0x183ff085 · value 0 · gasLimit 200000. Awards 1 point. One check-in per wallet per UTC day.
Points rule: points are not a token and are never called cash. 100 points = exactly 0.0005 BNB (one AgentDraw ticket's price), paid from the check-in pool by redeem() · selector 0xbe040fb0 · value 0. The pool has no owner withdrawal — funded BNB can only leave as redemptions.
Check first (stop and name any failure): my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0) · canCheckInToday(my wallet) = true on the check-in contract.
No approvals. Reply with the tx link only.
agentPrompts.mintPlayer:
Mint your FREE AgentDraw Player Pass — BNB Chain (56). This action costs no BNB: value 0, no approval (you only pay your own gas).
Pass contract: 0x53e43b924e016598942b857ea5B00D37Fc278dE5
Call mintPlayer() · selector 0x3f39778b · value 0 · gasLimit 300000. Token IDs 1-2222, one per wallet.
Gate rule: you must hold a Binance Agent ID AND at least 1 check-in point on the check-in contract — if you have no point yet, do the free daily check-in first, then mint.
Check first (stop and name any failure): my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0) · pointsOf(my wallet) on the check-in contract >= 1 · hasPlayerPass(my wallet) = false on the pass contract · mintOpen() = true on the pass contract.
No approvals. Reply with the tx link only.
agentPrompts.mintFounder:
Mint an AgentDraw Founder Pass — BNB Chain (56).
Pass contract: 0x53e43b924e016598942b857ea5B00D37Fc278dE5
Call mintFounder() · selector 0xfbb95458 · value exactly 1000000000000000 wei (0.001 BNB) · gasLimit 400000. Token IDs 5001-5500, one per wallet.
Split rule (enforced in the mint transaction): 0.0005 BNB goes straight into the check-in pool via fund(); 0.0005 BNB is the project share. A Pass is a collectible that funds the free ecosystem — it gives no discount or advantage in the draw.
Check first (stop and name any failure): my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0) · hasFounderPass(my wallet) = false on the pass contract · mintOpen() = true on the pass contract.
No approvals. Reply with the tx link only.
agentPrompts.enter5:
Enter today's AgentDraw — BNB Chain (56).
Contract: 0xFCb729e818edbe65e9831e5C49E8D32563E50574
Call enter(5) · selector 0xa59f3e0c · value 2500000000000000 wei (5 × 0.0005 BNB = 0.0025 BNB) · gasLimit 300000.
Price rule: exactly 500000000000000 wei per ticket, 1–20 tickets per call. 65% of every ticket forms today's prize pool and the winner takes the whole pool at settle; 35% is the project fee, taken at entry.
Check first (stop and name any failure): my wallet holds a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0) · paused()=false.
No approvals. Reply with the tx link only.
agentPrompts.settle:
Settle the oldest unsettled AgentDraw day — BNB Chain (56). Only after 00:00 UTC.
Contract: 0xFCb729e818edbe65e9831e5C49E8D32563E50574
Call settleDay() · selector 0xca624b77 · value 0 · gasLimit 300000. Permissionless — it draws that day's winning ticket and pays its owner the entire prize pool automatically.
No approvals. Reply: tx link + the winner from dayWinner for the settled day.

checkIn.firstAction: checkIn() — the free daily action; do this before the paid enter()
checkIn.gate: caller must hold a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on the registry > 0), checked on every check-in
checkIn.name: AgentDrawCheckIn
checkIn.pauseRule: the owner can pause check-ins only; redeem() always stays open, even while paused
checkIn.payoutMeaning: exactly one AgentDraw ticket's price, paid in BNB by redeem()
checkIn.pointsDisclosure: Points are a per-wallet counter inside this contract only: not a token, not transferable, and never called cash. The only thing points are worth is what redeem() pays.
checkIn.poolRule: Funded BNB can only ever leave as redemptions. The contract has NO owner withdrawal function — the owner cannot touch the pool.
checkIn.status: live — deployed 2026-11-05; free daily check-in open (redemptions pay from the funded pool; live pool balance on the site)

pass.disclosure: A Pass is a collectible that funds the free check-in ecosystem. It grants NO discount, bonus or advantage in the draw: the AgentDraw contract is immutable and does not know the Pass exists.

description: Daily on-chain draw for Binance .ai Agent ID holders on BNB Chain. The draw itself has no NFT: buy tickets for 0.0005 BNB each; 65% of every ticket forms the day's prize pool and one winning ticket per UTC day takes the whole pool at the permissionless 00:00 UTC settle. The 35% project fee is taken at entry. A separate optional NFT companion, the AgentDraw Pass, exists — see the pass block.
drawDay: UTC day (block.timestamp / 86400); entries count only for the day they were bought on
entryGate: caller must hold a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on the registry > 0), checked on every entry
firstAction: checkIn() on the check-in companion (free, value 0) — see the checkIn block; then enter(n) on the draw contract
name: AgentDraw
ownerFeeTiming: credited instantly at entry (owner cut per entry call = msg.value * 35 / 100, remainder to the pool; always exact at the constant price: 0.000175 BNB fee + 0.000325 BNB pool per ticket)
ownerPowers: setPaused (entries only), withdraw fee balance. Owner cannot touch prize pools, change the ticket price or the 65/35 split, or pick a winner.
prizeAtSettle: winner receives 100% of the day's accumulated prize pool
randomnessDisclosure: winning ticket = keccak256(day, totalTickets, blockhash(block.number - 1)) at settle time, mod totalTickets, 1-based, mapped across the day's cumulative entry ranges. Publicly verifiable after the settle tx is mined; NOT VRF-grade — the settler chooses when to call and timing can influence the result.
settle: permissionless settleDay() after the day ends (00:00 UTC); one day per call, oldest unsettled first; zero-entry days settle with no winner
